requirements.title: ADJUSTL argument STRING is character
requirements.definition: STRING for ADJUSTL shall be of type character.

pending.string-character-argument: Future source-control plan only: compile a conforming call ADJUSTL(CHARACTER(len=5) :: " AB ") as the positive control; do not require a diagnostic for a noncharacter argument because this is an unnumbered Clause 16 program restriction.

requirements.title: ADJUSTL result preserves STRING length and kind
requirements.definition: ADJUSTL returns character with the same length and kind type parameter as STRING.

pending.result-same-length: Call ADJUSTL on a length-5 character initialized to "  AB#" and assign to a length-5 result prefilled with "#####"; assert LEN(result)==5 and exact value "AB#  ", so length preservation is non-vacuous.
pending.result-same-kind: Call ADJUSTL on a default-character STRING initialized to "  AB#" and assert KIND(result)==KIND(STRING) together with exact value "AB#  "; the value check proves the result was produced by ADJUSTL and the kind check is portable for the required same-kind property.

requirements.title: ADJUSTL deletes leading blanks and inserts matching trailing blanks
requirements.definition: ADJUSTL produces the same string value except leading blanks are deleted and the same number of trailing blanks are inserted.

pending.leading-blanks-deleted: Call ADJUSTL("  AB#") into a result prefilled with "#####"; assert exact value "AB#  ", so the nonblank sentinel demonstrates that leading blanks were moved rather than default-filled.
pending.trailing-blanks-inserted: Use the same length-5 call and mutate the intrinsic to ADJUSTR or identity; the expected exact value "AB#  " distinguishes the required trailing blank insertion.
